cases.prompt: Produce a read-only architecture health review of this repository at the current commit.
Review the lifecycle subsystem for coupling and interface leakage; do not refactor it.
Assess whether this module is shallow and whether its callers suffer from poor locality.
Inspect this interface for evidence that internal policy leaks across its boundary.
Review whether this proposed seam has evidence beyond one adapter.
Run the architecture health review's deletion test on these repeated wrappers.
Assess the controlled fixture where a pass-through wrapper exposes every dependency; report observation, evidence, uncertainty, and an advisory candidate separately.
Review the healthy control with two genuinely varying adapters and a small caller-facing interface; avoid calling it a smell without contrary evidence.
For this explicitly high-consequence public compatibility interface, compare two materially different designs without choosing or implementing either.
Explain how an accepted architecture-review finding enters the ordinary managed task lifecycle without creating one now.
Format this Python file with the existing project formatter.
Run the focused unit test for this parser.
Implement the already approved refactor in this active managed task.
Create a Backlog issue for the accepted proposal.
Diagnose why this API request returns status 500.
Deploy the already approved service release.
Rewrite this paragraph to be more concise.
Review this authentication change for security issues.
Explain this SQL query plan.
Fetch the current release notes from the vendor site.

quality_comparisons.objective_verifier: The deterministic fixture test verifies that the selected canonical descriptor materializes the review protocol containing an exact revision, observation/evidence/uncertainty/proposal separation, a healthy-control requirement, and an explicit no-mutation boundary.
